Message.Name: Logon Message
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to establish a session.

Field.Name: User Name
Field.Description: User name

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password

Field.Name: New Password
Field.Description: New Password

Field.Name: Message Version
Field.Description: Message Version that will be used in this session.

Message.Name: Logon Reply Message
Message.Description: Allows the server to acknowledge a client's Logon.

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject.

Field.Name: Password Expiry Day Count
Field.Description: The number of days before the password will expire

Message.Name: Logout Message
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to terminate a session.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reason for the logout.

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to exercise the communication line during periods of inactivity and verify that the interfaces at each end are available.

Message.Name: Missed Message Request Message
Message.Description: Allows the client to subscribe to missed messages through the Recovery Channel.

Field.Name: App ID
Field.Description: App ID this message relates to.

Field.Name: Last Msg Seq Num
Field.Description: Last received Sequence No.

Message.Name: Missed Message Request Ack Message
Message.Description: Allows the server to acknowledge a client's Missed Message Request.

Field.Name: Missed Message Request Ack Response Type

Message.Name: Missed Message Report Message
Message.Description: Allows the server to communicate the result of a Missed Message Request.

Message.Name: Reject Message
Message.Description: Used to reject a message that does not comply with the Native Trading Gateway messaging protocol.

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject.

Field.Name: Reject Reason
Field.Description: Reject Reason.

Field.Name: Rejected Message Type
Field.Description: Message type of the rejected message.

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the rejected message if it is available.

Message.Name: System Status Message
Message.Description: Indicates service non availability of a partition, disseminated on the recovery and realtime channels.

Field.Name: App ID
Field.Description: Partition ID

Message.Name: Execution Report Message
Message.Description: Indicates order accepted, rejected, executed, expired, cancelled, cancel/replaced, restated or suspended, or a trade cancel.

Field.Name: App ID
Field.Description: Partition ID

Field.Name: Sequence No
Field.Description: Sequence number of the message.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Unique ID of the Execution Report.

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the order.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order assigned by the matching system.

Field.Name: Exec Type
Field.Description: The reason the Execution Report is being sent.

Field.Name: Execution Report Ref ID
Field.Description: Reference to the trade being cancelled or corrected.

Field.Name: Execution Report Order Status
Field.Description: The status of the order.

Field.Name: Order Reject Code
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject or the expiry.

Field.Name: Executed Price
Field.Description: Value of this fill.

Field.Name: Executed Qty
Field.Description: Quantity that was executed in this fill.

Field.Name: Leaves Qty
Field.Description: Quantity available for further execution.

Field.Name: Waiver Flags/Post Trade Flags
Field.Description: Pre-trade waiver or Post Trade flag.

Field.Name: Display Qty
Field.Description: Current visible quantity.

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument the Execution Report is sent for.

Field.Name: Restatement Reason
Field.Description: Reason order was restated or cancelled.

Field.Name: Execution Report Pegged Exec Inst
Field.Description: The instruction for permissioning to trade against mid-priced pegged orders.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: Owner Type
Field.Description: Not applicable for Quotes.

Field.Name: Reserved Field 2
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Counterparty
Field.Description: Counterparty Firm.

Field.Name: Trade Liquidity Indicator
Field.Description: Whether the order added or removed liquidity.

Field.Name: Trade Match ID
Field.Description: Identifier of the trade.

Field.Name: Transact Time
Field.Description: Time the Execution Report was generated.

Field.Name: LastMarket
Field.Description: Market (Segment MIC) where execution took place.

Field.Name: Type Of Trade
Field.Description: Indicates whether the executed portion of a passive order during continuous trading session is visible or hidden.

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the order.

Field.Name: Reserved Field 4
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Public Order ID
Field.Description: Maintained by matching engine, will be unique for each replenishment of a particular iceberg order.

Field.Name: Minimum Quantity
Field.Description: Minimum Execution Size (MES) specified on a pegged order.

Message.Name: Order Mass Cancel Report Message
Message.Description: Indicates that a mass order cancel request was accepted or rejected.

Field.Name: App ID
Field.Description: Partition ID

Field.Name: Sequence No
Field.Description: Sequence number of the message.

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of mass cancel request.

Field.Name: Mass Cancel Response
Field.Description: Whether the Mass Cancel Request was accepted or rejected.

Field.Name: Mass Cancel Reject Reason
Field.Description: The code that identifies the reason the order mass cancel was rejected.

Field.Name: Reserved Field 1
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Transact Time
Field.Description: Time the order mass cancel report was generated.

Field.Name: Reserved Field 2
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Message.Name: Quote Request Message
Message.Description: Carries a Request For Quote. Sent by the Requester to submit an RFQ, and by the server to deliver it to the Market Maker.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: The server will stamp the identifier of the matching partition for the instrument

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: The server will stamp the message sequence number of the matching partition.

Field.Name: Quote Req ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the RFQ.

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Instrument ID of the instrument

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the Quote Request.

Field.Name: Order Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity that the Requester is expecting to trade.

Field.Name: Expire Time
Field.Description: Indicates the date or the time the RFQ expires, in Unix (Posix) time format (number of seconds after 1 January 1970).

Field.Name: Market Makers
Field.Description: Pipe separated list of Firm IDs, if it is required to target this quote request to specific Market Makers.

Field.Name: Contra Trader
Field.Description: For Named Models only, the server will stamp the User ID of the Requester to send to the Market Maker.

Field.Name: Contra Firm
Field.Description: For Named Models only, the server will stamp the Firm ID of the Requester to send to the Market Maker.

Field.Name: RFQ ID
Field.Description: The unique identifier of the initial RFQ automatically generated via the server.

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: Identifier of the client.

Field.Name: Investment Decision Maker
Field.Description: Identifier of the trading member/participant who made investment decision.

Field.Name: Executing Trader
Field.Description: Identifier of the trading member/participant who made the execution decision.

Field.Name: MiFID Flags
Field.Description: Flags introduced to identify DEA involvement, Algo and Liquidity provision activity.

Field.Name: Party Role Qualifiers
Field.Description: Provides a further qualification for the value specified via the ‘Client ID’, ‘Investment Decision Maker’ and ‘Executing Trader’ fields.

Field.Name: Quote Request Type
Field.Description: Indicates the type of Quote Request

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit Price.

Field.Name: RFQ Execution Delay
Field.Description: The minimum number of seconds from the time of RFQ submission to be elapsed for the RFQ execution to be triggered automatically.

Field.Name: RFQ Min Quotes
Field.Description: The minimum number of market maker quotes to be available for the RFQ execution to be triggered automatically.

Field.Name: Account Type
Field.Description: Clearing Account Type.

Field.Name: Order Capacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the RFQ.

Field.Name: RFQ Disclose Side
Field.Description: Instructs the system whether to disclose the side of the request as stated in the Side field to the market makers or not.

Field.Name: Expire Time Milliseconds
Field.Description: Indicates the number of milliseconds to be added to the date or the time the RFQ expires on specified in the ‘Expire Time’ field.

Field.Name: AutoRFQExecStrategy
Field.Description: This field will include the applicable Auto RFQ Execution Strategy ‘Sub LIS Auction with Order Book Sweep or LIS Winner Takes All’ model.

Field.Name: NumOfCompetitors
Field.Description: The number of competing Respondents (the total number of market maker firms) the quote request has been routed to.

Field.Name: Market Maker Rank
Field.Description: The rank of the market makers the request should be routed to.

Message.Name: Quote Status Report Message
Message.Description: Allows the server to communicate the status of the RFQ to the Requester.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: The server will stamp the identifier of the matching partition for the instrument.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: The server will stamp the message sequence number of the matching partition.

Field.Name: Quote Msg Id
Field.Description: Identifier specified by the client in the RFQ modification/cancellation/execution request.

Field.Name: Quote Req ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the RFQ that is being responded to.

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Reject code.

Field.Name: Market Makers
Field.Description: Pipe separated list of MM Firm IDs where specified by Requester otherwise null.

Field.Name: RFQ ID
Field.Description: The unique identifier of the RFQ automatically generated via the server.

Field.Name: Expire Time
Field.Description: Indicates the date or the time the RFQ expires, in Unix (Posix) time format (number of seconds after 1 January 1970).

Field.Name: Bid ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier assigned to the bid side of the quote.

Field.Name: Offer ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier assigned to the offer side of the quote.

Field.Name: Expire Time Milliseconds
Field.Description: Indicates the number of milliseconds to be added to the date or time the RFQ expires on specified in the ‘Expire Time’ field.

Message.Name: Quote Request Reject Message
Message.Description: Rejects an RFQ. Sent by the Market Maker to reject, and by the server to reject or to relay a Market Maker rejection.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: The server will stamp the identifier of the matching partition for the instrument.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: The server will stamp the message sequence number of the matching partition.

Field.Name: Quote Req ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the RFQ being rejected.

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Reject code.

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Instrument ID of the instrument

Field.Name: Order Quantity
Field.Description: Only valid when the server rejects the RFQ, with the quantity specified in the RFQ message.

Field.Name: Market Makers
Field.Description: Contains the pipe separated list of Market Maker Firm IDs (or null) as specified by the Requester if the message was generated by the server to reject an RFQ.

Field.Name: Contra Trader
Field.Description: Contains the individual Market Maker ID if the message is sent by the server to the Requester to communicate the rejection by the Market Maker.

Field.Name: RFQ ID
Field.Description: The unique identifier of the RFQ that was automatically generated via the server.

Message.Name: RFQ Quote Message
Message.Description: Carries an RFQ Quote. Sent by the Market Maker to accept an RFQ, and by the server to deliver the quote to the Requester.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: The server will stamp the identifier of the matching partition for the instrument.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: The server will stamp the message sequence number of the matching partition.

Field.Name: Quote Msg ID
Field.Description: Identifier of the RFQ quote request that is being accepted.

Field.Name: RFQ ID
Field.Description: Unique identifier assigned to the RFQ by the system.

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument.

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: Bid price.

Field.Name: Bid Quantity
Field.Description: Bid quantity.

Field.Name: Offer Price
Field.Description: Offer price.

Field.Name: Offer Quantity
Field.Description: Offer quantity.

Field.Name: Auto Cancel
Field.Description: Value is specified by MM in RFQ Quote.

Field.Name: Market Maker
Field.Description: The Market Maker ID who is the owner of the quote.

Field.Name: Market Maker Firm
Field.Description: The Market Makers’ Firm ID.

Field.Name: Bid ID
Field.Description: Only populated for Named models.

Field.Name: Offer ID
Field.Description: System generated Order ID for the Bid Side of the RFQ.

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the quote.

Field.Name: Clearing Account
Field.Description: Clearing Account Type.

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: Identifier of the client.

Field.Name: Investment Decision Maker
Field.Description: Identifier of the trading member/participant who made investment decision.

Field.Name: Executing Trader
Field.Description: Identifier of the trading member/participant who made the execution decision.

Field.Name: MiFID Flags
Field.Description: Flags introduced to identify DEA involvement, Algo and Liquidity provision activity.

Field.Name: Party Role Qualifiers
Field.Description: Provides a further qualification for the value specified via the ‘Client ID’, ‘Investment Decision Maker’ and ‘Executing Trader’ fields.
